description: Spend part of E069's banked margin on the cheapest time cut found so far: freeze block 1 earlier. Base: E069 (commit 5ed8687; Polar Express NS3 coefficients with output rescaled to NS3's Frobenius norm, bs 1536, 20/28/32 px curriculum at 0-1.5/1.5-3.5/3.5-6.75 epochs, head x2, Muon lr 0.16 mom 0.8, lookahead 0.97^5, jitter, whitening bias trained in epoch 1 only, block 1 frozen from 0.8). Make one change: switch to the existing block-1-frozen graph pair at sample 236250 (0.7 of samples, E061's point) instead of 270000. That pair is the detached block-1 output with the Muon variant without the block-1 groups (now running the Polar Express coefficients), with block-1 BN biases skipped in SGD. Split the straddling step into the two partial shapes, as E061 did. Reuse E061's partial-shape warmups with channels_last tensors in the exact timed layout (E035), and confirm that the Polar Express Muon variant without block 1 is warmed at those shapes. Run debug_nan.py and compare trial-0 with later-trial times. Do not anneal block 1 first: E067 showed the anneal adds nothing.
